title: statusmodel.runCompleted reads any run_finished line as completion, including a failed incarnation's
body: runCompleted (internal/statusmodel/build.go) scans the whole feed for ANY run_finished line, so a resumed run whose first incarnation ended failed reads as completed for the WaitMerge wait; only m.CI being nil in most checkouts hides it. A failed-then-resumed epic with an open PR could surface a merge wait (and, through the watch's now model-based exit, a held 3) for a run that is not completed. Discovered while unifying the watch's exit code on the model in 4mv; not changed there because CI==nil guards it today.
